purpose: Paired development comparison of four versus ten observed frames under identical window labels, data splits and classifier capacity. Not a final independent test, temporal-order model or deployed device benchmark.

selection.anchor: LTA annotation context midpoint proxy, not observed action completion

input.sampling: Nearest actual decoded source frame at or before requested time; no interpolation or future frame; ten distinct source frames within target

future_teacher.repeat_selection: one per split and stratum before outputs
future_teacher.payload: Only anonymous item/frame IDs, target times and designated 224px PNGs; no reference/candidate labels, source annotations, prior predictions or audit video

labels.accepted: Teacher and independent blind image reviewer agree on present or absent; reviewer has not seen teacher, source annotations or candidate stratum. Any predeclared repeat must agree. Accepted present needs chronological before/after evidence on the same event within target. Accepted absent needs visible non-target evidence. Unknown, disagreement, missing result or inadequate evidence stays null. No source-video answers backfilled into sampled-input labels.
labels.source: AI-consensus weak labels, not human gold; no soft-logit distillation
labels.gate_failure: Stop. Keep original assignments, null labels and failure report; do not move split, window or silently refill.

model.summary: concatenate temporal mean, temporal max, last minus first
model.head: Linear(1728,1)
model.interpretation: Additional middle frames affect unordered mean/max; identical endpoints make last-first identical across arms. This is not a learned temporal-order model.

optimization.checkpoint_selection: fixed final epoch 40; no dev or epoch selection
optimization.normalization: per-arm summary features, accepted-train-only mean and population std, std clamp min 0.05

evaluation.prior24: Reserved seen diagnostics only, excluded from training and development comparison; any later replay explicitly separate
